page.title: Long match box at the shop

product.name: Long match box
product.description: Nothing in the pack beyond long matches, filled at a splitting bench on Wednesday, batch clay pail forty two.

blocks.text: A Thursday fill at the wood yard put long matches into a crate, batch pine hook sixty eight.
Batch ash nook eighty one names the match room and mentions hand splitting.
The yard crew signed the slip Wednesday because the tips stay firm, batch slate bin fifty five.

trick.evidence_text: sixty five dollars and sixty one cents
trick.instruction: The shelf figure was $59.68 and this page asks sixty five dollars and sixty one cents. Stop when the errand cap is under the higher figure.
